bulk.title: Bulk CSV upload
bulk.subtitle: Add or update many products at once with a spreadsheet.
bulk.step1: Download the template (or export your products).
bulk.step2: Fill one row per variant. Rows with the same product title become one product.
bulk.step3: Validate the file and fix any errors.
bulk.step4: Import. Existing SKUs update price, stock and barcode; new SKUs become draft products.
bulk.rules: Prices in rupees. Up to 1,000 rows and 2 MB per file.
bulk.importHint: We check every row first, so nothing changes until the file is clean.
bulk.drop: Drop your CSV here or click to choose
bulk.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
bulk.summary: {{rows}} rows · {{created}} new variants in {{products}} products · {{updated}} updated
bulk.errorsBody: Fix these rows in your spreadsheet and validate again. Nothing was imported.

codes.DUPLICATE_SKU: This SKU appears more than once in the file.
